subject.title: fix: add exact and prefix skill search modes

question: Should ClawHub make `mode=prefix|exact` with a 200-result cap and no pagination the supported public API/CLI contract for registry-style skill discovery?
rationale: The linked issue asks for reliable enumeration and counting, while this branch deliberately exposes a bounded result-only API; correctness tests cannot choose the long-term discovery semantics.

options.title: Approve bounded modes
options.body: Accept the documented 200-result deterministic prefix/exact contract after real backend proof confirms the indexed path and filters behave correctly.

options.title: Require enumeration metadata
options.body: Ask for pagination, a cursor, a total, or an explicit truncation signal before exposing prefix mode as a registry-listing interface.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded modes
recommendation.body: Accept the documented 200-result deterministic prefix/exact contract after real backend proof confirms the indexed path and filters behave correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: They can clarify the proposed API semantics and supply the requested runtime proof; a repository owner should make the final public-contract decision.
